calls.title: Hope Ruiz and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: Growth Book aims to double its revenue from $4 million to $8 million this fiscal year, with aspirations to reach $12 million next year. CEO Ashley Stirrup emphasized the importance of a solid foundation with a team of 30 employees and a client roster that includes leading AI firms like Anthropic, XAI, and Mistral. The company plans to invest heavily in sales and marketing, with a current revenue split of one-third self-serve and two-thirds enterprise sales. Hope Ruiz highlighted a marketing strategy shift towards product-led growth and enterprise demand generation, leveraging channels like LinkedIn and Google Ads. Improvements in user onboarding and engagement scoring could significantly boost self-serve conversion rates, while strong sales and marketing alignment is critical for scaling the enterprise motion. Additionally, the marketing team is set to expand from 2 to about 10 members by year-end to bolster these efforts.
calls.keywords: Product-Led Growth, Inbound Marketing, Pipeline Generation, Freemium Model, Sales-Marketing Alignment, Cybersecurity Marketing
calls.action_items:
**Ashley Stirrup**
Finalize the marketing team hiring plan aiming for ~10 members by year-end, focusing on product marketing and demand gen (25:30)
Continue collaboration with sales to refine pipeline development strategies and fully integrate marketing support for enterprise deals and self-serve growth (15:50)
Accelerate fill of headcount in marketing role with a focus on building product-led growth motion while supporting enterprise sales (26:50)

**Hope Ruiz**
Conduct customer interviews and review sales call recordings to identify main buying drivers and optimize marketing channels (10:45)
Develop onboarding nurture flows and product usage scoring models to increase freemium to paid conversion rates, aiming for 10% conversion by 2026 end (24:00)
Work closely with sales leadership to define target account lists and implement marketing/sales cadence meetings to optimize pipeline contribution (15:30)
Onboard and leverage tools like Common Room to aggregate intent signals from multiple sources to prioritize sales engagement (07:30)
Design multi-channel campaigns including LinkedIn, Google Ads, and potentially revisit Reddit with a thought leadership approach to generate awareness and early interest (06:40)
